record.dic_text:
0932 Bohan {bo:'-han}

0931 的拼法變化型; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Bohan 2; 2

波罕 = "拇指"
1) 流便人, 在猶大和便雅憫之間放分界石的人
2) (BDB) 猶大和便雅憫分界的標記 (#書 15:6; 18:17|)
record.edic_text:
0932 Bohan {bo'han}

an orthographical variation of 0931;; n pr m

AV - Bohan 2; 2

Bohan = "thumb"
1) a Reubenite who set a boundary stone between Judah and Benjamin
2) (BDB) a mark of division between Judah and Benjamin
